home.aboutText1: SCL-90 (Symptom Checklist-90) includes 90 items across 10 dimensions (somatization, obsessive-compulsive, interpersonal sensitivity, etc.), and is an internationally widely used mental health assessment tool. This scale can help you understand your mental health status, identify potential issues early, and receive professional advice.
home.aboutText2: Using this system for assessment is completely private. All data is stored only on your local device and will not be uploaded to any server.
home.testimonialText: The SCL-90 assessment helped me better understand my mental health status. The interface is clean and easy to use, and the reports are detailed and professional.
